key_events: Giselle paints Mr. Whitmore's silhouette in the study window and accidentally creates a bright red streak.
Giselle decides to cover the red streak with white paint the next morning.
Giselle begins painting a golden rain scene on her canvas.
Giselle adds Vin and Bran to the canvas as quick silver fireflies.
Giselle paints Laurie, noting light pooling around him.
Giselle paints Lucius as a fading grey figure, suggesting his grief.
